title: QUIZ - 14
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.concept: Calculating a Percentage of a Number
questions.learningObjective: Calculate a given percentage of a whole number value
questions.question: What is 5% of 220?
questions.hint: Convert the percentage to a decimal or fraction, then multiply by the base value.

questions.concept: Applying Percentages in Word Problems
questions.learningObjective: Apply a percentage to a real-world total to find a count
questions.question: Out of 304 people surveyed, 12% work remotely. How many people does this represent (rounded to the nearest whole number)?
questions.explanation: 12% of 304 is \(12/100 \times 304 = 36.48\), which rounds to 36 people.
questions.hint: Multiply the percentage (as a decimal) by the total number of people.

questions.concept: Sequential (Nested) Percentage Calculations
questions.learningObjective: Calculate a percentage of a percentage of a base value
questions.question: What is 5% of 10% of 134?
questions.explanation: First find 10% of 134: 13.4. Then find 5% of that result: \(5/100 \times 13.4 = 0.67\).
questions.hint: Apply the percentages one at a time, in sequence, rather than adding them together.
